select message.*, student.nick_name as stu_name, student.avatar as stu_img, teachers.name as tea_name, teachers.head_img as tea_img from message message left join users student on message.send_user_id = student.id left join teacher teachers on message.accept_user_id = teachers.id
and message.id = #{id} and message.send_user_id = #{sendUserId} and message.accept_user_id = #{acceptUserId} and message.create_time = #{createTime} and student.nick_name like concat('%',#{stuName},'%') and teachers.name like concat('%',#{teaName},'%')
order by id desc
limit #{current},#{pageSize}
